Get Turbo Browser ↓

This first release is unsigned and has no automatic updater. Windows may display a publisher warning. Review the source and release checksums before running it; get updates from GitHub Releases.

You’ll need Node.js and Git. Open a terminal, then run:

TERMINAL
git clone https://github.com/TurboTwitch0/turbo-browser-native.git
cd turbo-browser-native
npm ci
npm start

Chromium is included through Electron. You don’t need Chrome, Edge, or another installed browser to run Turbo.

03 / GOOD TO KNOW

A few things
before you go.

Is this really a browser?+

Yes. The downloadable Windows app embeds Chromium through Electron and renders websites in its own tabs. This website is the app’s download and information page; the browser itself runs on your computer.

Where does my browsing data live?+

Normal tabs use a local browser profile on your computer. Bookmarks, history, and settings are saved locally. Private tabs use a temporary session and don’t add entries to your saved history. Websites and search providers still receive the requests you make.

What’s included in this first release?+

Tabs, an address and search bar, back and forward navigation, bookmarks, history, downloads, private tabs, and page search. There is no built-in account sync or automatic updater. Some protected media and browser-specific sign-in flows may have compatibility limitations.

Can I change it or build for another platform?+

The source is on GitHub. Start with the README for setup, tests, and packaging. The supplied download is for Windows x64; other operating systems need their own builds and testing.
